// Positive control (#5170): a gate probe whose catch collapses "could not look" into a literal answer.
import fs from 'node:fs';

export function fixtureProbeExists(target: string): boolean {
  try {
    fs.statSync(target);
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    return false;
  }
}

export function fixtureProbeText(target: string): string | null {
  let value: string | null = null;
  try {
    value = fs.readFileSync(target, 'utf8');
  } catch {
    value = null;
  }
  return value;
}
